summary: Verified the Dockerized service end-to-end with successful build, healthy runtime, non-root execution, and passing live/readiness checks; identified remaining optimization gap on image size target.
evidence: Build check: docker build -t myservice . completed successfully.
Runtime check: docker run launched container with required env vars; endpoint validation returned LIVE 200 and READY 200 on mapped host port 3301.
Non-root check: docker exec myservice-test whoami returned appuser.
Image size check: docker images myservice --format '{{.Size}}' returned 269MB (above 200MB target).
Cleanup completed: docker stop myservice-test && docker rm myservice-test.
Conceptual validation: Docker layer caching is sensitive to instruction order; placing COPY . before dependency install invalidates downstream cache on every source change.
Conceptual validation: each Dockerfile instruction creates a cached filesystem layer snapshot; multi-stage reduces runtime image by excluding build-time artifacts and tools.
